notes:
Race Engineer 0.6.0

A small release: one new button, and nothing else changed. Everything from
0.5.0 stays as it is.

New

* Report a problem without hunting for where. A "Report an issue" button in
  the header opens the report form on iraceengineer.com in your browser. The
  form has been there for a while — the app just never said so. Tell us what
  broke, and optionally leave an email if you want a reply.

The app itself collects and sends nothing. Clicking the button opens your
browser, exactly like the support link next to it; the report is written on
the website, as it always was.
